title: DAG Execution Workspace

designSystem.name: Minions Obsidian
designSystem.notes: Uses the repository's Obsidian color, typography, border, radius, and status language as a binding visual constraint.

deliverables.kind: implementation-facing observable state and transition contract
prototype coverage and local validation report
production visual audit and repair disposition

designDecisions: The authored plan is a persistent rail rather than another graph layer.
Leaders, minions, and checkpoints use distinct visual grammar while runtime state stays secondary.
Context checkpoints are inspectable transfer objects, not unlabeled edges.
Flow, Plan map, and Context lineage are synchronized lenses over one selection.
The canvas shows a compact execution preview; the full graph remains in a dedicated workspace.
Activity owns cross-work triage while Graph Inspector owns diagnosis and fenced intervention.
Completion review, removal, and promotion remain separate user-driven transitions.
Responsive breakpoints are automatic; rail disclosure and selection-driven inspection are user-controlled.

implementation.mappingPolicy: Authored plan items map only by canonical task ID or minion session identity; context checkpoints are projected from server evidence lineage.
